notes: First experimental search for ultralight dark matter using magnetically levitated particle. Constrains B−L gauge coupling in mass range (1.10360–1.10485)×10^−13 eV/c². Best limit g_BL ≲ 2.98×10^−21 at m_DM ≈ 1.1042×10^−13 eV/c² (f_DM ≈ 26.6995 Hz). No signal detected; 90% CL limit derived from force power spectral density analysis. Local DM density ρ_DM ≈ 0.4 GeV/c² cm³ used in theoretical calculations. Paper also proposes POLONAISE upgrades with projected sensitivities shown in Fig. 4 (marked as projections, not included in data_points).
